actions.description: It will remove optical smudge residues

Take a clean dry microfiber cloth.
Gently wipe each camera lens in circular motions until clear.

actions.description: It will restore default camera configurations

steps: Open Camera app and tap the Settings gear icon.
Scroll all the way down to the bottom of the menu.
Tap Reset settings.
Tap Reset to confirm returning camera options to default.
